summary: Identify the renamed product with an algebra-homomorphism image (aevalTower of the renamed Fock letters) of the first-column inclusion, and expand.

steps.claim: Rewrite the renamed product as (aevalTower(renaming by g, renamed Fock letters by f)) ∘ inFirstCols (to be shown, steps 3–4);
steps.lean:
rw [(?_ : renameRowsCols .. = (aevalTower (renameRowsCols id g) (renameRowsCols id f <|
    fockLetters _ _ 1 <| .X ·)).comp inFirstCols)]

steps.claim: then expanding the determinants and the polynomials (letterPoly, tableau polynomials, minors) and swapping the sums gives the claimed sum.
steps.lean:
simpa [← toPoly_linePolyCoords, toPoly, letterPoly, entrywise, nablaBasis, tableauPoly, minor,
    smul_eq_C_mul, AlgHom.map_det, Matrix.map,
    Fintype.linearCombination_apply, sum_mul, mul_right_comm _ (rename _ _)] using! sum_comm

steps.claim: The identity on generators: compare at each variable;
steps.lean: ext1 ⟨τ, a, s | s⟩ <;> simp [inFirstCols, fockLetters, auxPair]

steps.claim: a sum with a single nonzero term (the basis-number bijection).
